rationale: The description details EVM reporting, cost controls, performance measurement, rate scenarios, what-if cost modeling, and project audits—meaningful conventional project-control functions.
evidence_spans: Integrate cost and schedule, establish cost controls, measure performance and forecast outcomes to help projects succeed.
Unlimited rate scenarios and top-down planning allow what-if analysis and modeling cost impacts
Easily produce detailed and summary reports and support project audits
conflict_response: Although ‘forecast outcomes’ alone does not identify a method, the description explains rate scenarios and what-if modeling of cost impacts alongside conventional EVM controls/reporting. It does not claim learned prediction or AI, and the concrete project-planning functions support a conventional negative without assuming every forecast mechanism.
